interactive.rationale: Drag-to-resize stage with ResizeObserver readout, plus a new width slider wired to the same stage so keyboard and touch users can drive the core demo; pills, live code annotations and the card all respond (driven headless through 700→300→220px).

blurb_alignment.rationale: The index card promises drag-resize, live status badges and the <250px/>500px blue-border OR rule, which the page implements; the stale 'Chrome 149' card tag now reads 'Chrome 150+ (listed in 149)' per the lineage note.

edge_cases.rationale: Engine-vs-expected disagreement now surfaces a requires-Chrome-150 support note (hidden on this supporting build, verified), and the annotated code block distinguishes per-clause expectation from the engine's applied result.

conformance.rationale: The shared feature suite runs 4 pass / 1 fail on Chromium 153; the four real parse/CSSOM contracts pass (the fifth is flagged for a human on the breakpoint-matrix critique).

runtime_evidence.rationale: chrome-devtools-mcp is unavailable in this cloud session, so per auto-research.md §0 this is NOT MCP browser verification — but every control was driven via headless Chromium 153 (Playwright/CDP over the real Chrome binary): slider sweeps through both breakpoints and the narrow clause, pills/code/card observed agreeing with the engine, zero console errors and failed requests, screenshots read at 1280×800 and 360×740 DPR3, re-run fresh after the final edit.

telemetry_health.rationale: The page asserts `multi-cond-engine-matches-expected` (sentinel readback vs clause arithmetic) on every resize, so parser drops or false-success states surface in telemetry.

design_system.rationale: Variables throughout; walkthrough and pill on-states set background and color together.

accessibility.rationale: The match row is a polite live region, the new slider is a labelled native range input giving a keyboard path to the width axis, and the walkthrough panel already had live output and real buttons.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Verified at 360×740 DPR3 touch and 1280×800: no horizontal overflow, and the slider makes every breakpoint reachable on touch where the CSS resize corner is unusable — all three width states driven on both classes.

summary: Repaired 2026-10-25 (weekly hardening): rule-match state is now derived from the engine — the two @container rules set --rule1-match/--rule2-match sentinels on the card and the pills/annotated code read them back with getComputedStyle, with clause arithmetic shown only as the expected state, a requires-Chrome-150 note on disagreement, and a telemetry assert pinning agreement. Added a width slider wired to the same stage (keyboard/touch path), made the match row a live region, and corrected the ship-milestone copy to Chrome 150. Verified on headless Chromium 153 (no chrome-devtools-mcp in this cloud session): pills and card agreed with the engine at 700px (both rules), 300px (neither) and 220px (comma rule via narrow clause) on desktop and mobile, clean console/network, fresh reload after the final edit.
